notes.title: Moonless Knight release date!
notes.notes:
October 31st 2019.

Yes, in two months.

I could release early October but I rather make sure I polish it up as much as possible. 
It already contains more options and comfort settings than all 3 of my games combined, which is hard as the engine can be a total headache.

Overall this game will feature the widest spectrum of gameplay styles of my games yet, with the absolute most open structure yet. More open than basically any Metroidvania, but not falling over the edge into open world.

Please look forward to the release and make sure to wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029170/Skautfold_Moonless_Knight/

It has been a really hard time for me both due to financial difficulties and struggling with depression, still I feel like this will be by far my best work yet.

notes.title: #Patch 32
notes.notes:
Changes:

-Summon system overhaul:
Summoning is now viable. the system now works as follows. Upon using the proper weapon(the books) hitting the enemy will roll your Eld stat against 100, meaning your Eld literally translates to a % chance. After this the game checks your DEVOTION against 100, meaning 1000 donated is 1% chance, while 100.000 vitae donated equals 100% chance to summon if the Eldritch check passes. But after the summoning is complete your chance to summon is reduced by 1 donation's worth. Now the system is viable to play but requires constant feeding, in return however.... you get full screen wipes in most cases.

-Flight now provides a guard regen, half of your normal on ground regen, this is a massive change in terms of how flight and late game works.

-Teleport blade upgrade mechanic implemented. You can now find and collect Shift Blade upgrades, each providing one more teleportation before you need to touche the ground or a wall. This means you can chain them for as long as 10 times when you find them all. This makes the shift blade a LOT stronger once upgraded and will provide ludicrous amounts of mobility.

-Overall damage formula altered to reduce incoming damage slightly.

-New game plus incoming damage increase reduced significantly.

-Pet damage is roughly doubled.

-Sniper boss mines now have a warning cue and are delayed slightly.

-Veimar boss cone timings and warning cue is improved.

-Robot suiciders now have a better warning cue.

-Final boss AI is slowed down for a bit more breathing room.

notes.title: Into the Fray release date set.
notes.notes:
December 5th.

Into the Fray will be leaving Early Access on the 5th of December.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

The game is a direct sequel to both Shrouded in Sanity and Usurper, and features Hito the 3rd Knight as the protagonist.

The game will receive post launch support in the form of more modes and silly extras, but the release version will already feature a lot of extras. Like the obvious Steam stuff like Achievements and Trading cards.

Once out of EA development on the next game begins immediately, while ItF will receive periodic smaller additions to tie over. No DLC plans. If you are interested in the 4th game in the series you can always pop into our Discord and take a look and have your say, discord users had a lot of influence on me over the last game.

Additionally Christmas will bring a nice surprise regarding Usurper if everything goes well, as a thank you to all who support my weird series of games with different genres each time.

notes.title: Hotfix, save issues after update.
notes.notes:
I attempted to perfectly recover all saves, however in case your save will load you into an incorrect area please edit your save file.

Your files can be located in your user folder, usually:  C:\Users\YOUR USER NAME\AppData\Local\Usurper

Find the save file with the correct number.

Change the appropriate lines to look like this:

savex="997.000000"
savey="1013.000000"
saveroom="5.000000"


I apologise for the issue but due to backups being outdated I was unable to recover the saves perfectly.

notes.title: Patch #30 Eraen mode.
notes.notes:
Added:

---New playable character, to access him you need to have finished the game once. 

This character plays very similar to Saragat, however he gains all relics with the exception of the last from the start.
This means he can fly, also unlike Saragat he can regenerate Guard mid flight...

In his mode you have to kill all bosses to access the final boss, beating him unlocks a new achievement. Bosses can be killed in any order you'd like, but all of them have to die.

Eraen mode has no story, and several npcs are removed, and the remaining ones cannot talk to you, but you can still use their stores and other functionality.


Next update shall be boss rush mode, with a random twist, look forward to that.

notes.title: #Patch 8
notes.notes:
Changes:

--- Drastic changes to Guard system. Rolling through an attack will now recover the full cost of a roll, and the full dmg you would have taken, as opposed to half of it as it was before. This might make the game too easy, but I feel like the reduced recovery was not allowing for the actual intention of allowing the player to take a hit while attacking following a roll.

--- Map system drastic changes. All maps are now perfectly accurate and display all save and boss/relic locations, as well as all major area's names. The tiers differ in how much is hidden.

--- Map zoom drastically increased, resetting zoom will center the map again.



With these changes I fell the map is now more than sufficient for navigation. Consider the GUI always displays where you are, and finding it was never easier.

notes.title: #Patch 6
notes.notes:
ANNOUNCEMENT:
For the next update I plan to add an optional faster movement speed, this will be accessible any time form the settings in the pause menu(or tittle screen) it will allow you to run considerably faster, however a note will inform the player this is not the intended way to play. I personally think the speed is perfect and the game was designed around it, therefore I am against changing it by default, however as an optional setting, I am ok with this.

I was considering other options like an after death speed buff for a few minutes but I believe this is the best solution.

--- Summon system altered slightly for better hinting of use, some dialogue altered to help.

--- Fog debuff weakened, it will also apply slower.

--- Nighgaunt spears made much more visible, their frequency lowered slightly.


Added:

notes.title: 1.0 Version Update - Out of Early Access!
notes.notes:
Early Access is over! (Some thoughts on that after the patch notes.)

Added:

 New game plus - This includes increased difficulty and carry over of all character stats and weapons. This has no limit, so technically reaching max level is now possible. (To trigger, reach the credits and the option becomes available.)
 2 new optional bosses - Killing one disables a certain type of enemy around the citadel for good.
 10 new weapons - Including the Spells, buy them at the now open store.
 Shops! - All shops are now open.
 Maps - 3 more map tiers to buy.
 Summons (A certain weapon found early on will be required).
 Summon donations system, and store.
 Pets - 3 new pets.
 New NPC - In the core room after a certain story point, with more lore.
 1 more big area.
 Lore - 30 more lore "stars" added.
 20 more tubes, and Yth stones placed.
 Further sanity system implementation.
 Music - 2 new songs to fit the new areas. 


Changed:


Guard regen rates drastically altered. Kneeling will now double regen rate for natural regen.
All weapon placements changed for better progression, and rewarding returning to older areas.
Some bosses AI slightly altered.
All bosses HP levels altered for better balance. (Especially later bosses.)
New game plus boss AI improved, HP levels rise appropriately.
New game plus enemy scaling.
New game plus traps and ambushes placed. (Enjoy.)
Final scene missing effects added.
Pug hit punishment implemented.


Fixed:


Further boss AI abuse fixes.
Mirror transitions in certain areas fixed.
Further sequence breaking prevention.
Fixed certain walls that could make the player get stuck after kneeling down.
Incorrect pet spawns upon loading/respawn should be fixed now.
Help screen completely redone.


I most likely missed stuff in the notes.

THOUGHTS, AND THANKS

With this, the game is content complete and we exit Early Access.
HOWEVER, this does not mean support and additional content will stop. Just like with Shrouded in Sanity, you can expect further modes, bosses, pets, music, and even areas added to the game, as well as the obvious continued bug fixing and support.

I would like to especially thank everyone who bought the Early Access version of the game and trusted me to finish Usurper, I hope I can deliver a fun game worthy of the purchase and trust.

I'd also like to thank everyone on our Discord server who helped directly or indirectly. (The link to which is at the bottom of this announcement.)

Special thanks to Ravness for being an incredibly helpful source of detailed bug reports.


JOIN OUR DISCORD

Join our Discord server!

As always, we strongly recommend that you join our Discord server if you want to be completely up-to-date, or just want to hang out. We are extremely active on there, posting updates and screenshots most days. And if you're worried about spoilers, we have dedicated rooms for those, so they're easy to avoid. It's also super convenient for us to receive bug reports since you can post images, but it's also a direct way to give us suggestions and other comments. 

Thank you all for continuing to support us!
Pugware

Fixed;

-3rd boss inactivity resolved.

-2nd boss roar effect not vanishing properly.

-Spear sound effect issues resolved.

-A certain skip can no longer be performed, nice try....

-A certain  collision box visibility resolved.

notes.title: Patch #7 Full gamepad support LIVE.
notes.notes:
Added;

-Full gamepad support for all actions and menus, in additions to all controls re-labeled to match gamepad input as well.

-Full gamepad remapping.

-Sprites for both Sony and Microsoft controller inputs for easy readability.

-Analog, or D-pad movement, with weapon cross moving to opposite function.

-All menus now accept Analog and Dpad inputs simultaneously. (Might have missed a few things so please report if  found)

-Spear sounds.


Fixed;

-No more rolling, jumping, etc in cutscenes while playing with gamepad...




Next update will focus on a few fixes still in the air, before focusing on adding new content.

notes.title: Patch #5
notes.notes:
Added;

- Bosses viate drops.

- Further work on the gamepad to allow for remapping in a further update.

- Actual blocking to prevent the progress of players unless they posses a certain relic.


Changed;

- Work on multiple enemies AI to add more aggression.

- 6th boss AI misshaps fixed.

- 7th boss trigger issues resolved.

- 1st boss door lighting chnaged for more obvious effect.

- Entire room save system overhauled this should fix a lot of issues including ending out of bounds, bosses triggering empty cutscenes, bosses not triggering, etc. This took a lot of work but now we have a full room save system that only resets when the player either dies, or actually saves the game.

notes.title: Gamepad support Patch #2
notes.notes:
This patch will undergo several updates throughout the day, I am trying to finish this, but due to the first version being rushed it caused a few complications.

Now the game will default to controller input if its found in slot 0.

This is important, if you have issues of your controller not being recognized try different USB ports.

Changes;

-4th boss ricochet shot added, no more cheese.

-Dock workers now turn on axis to stop your cheese.

-Cucumbers also had enough of the cheese.

(enemy AI is currently to easy to abuse this will be adjusted and the cheese shall end)

notes.title: Gamepad support RAW version.
notes.notes:
Everything should work with gamepads now, however it's a very early version. 

Tomorrow's update will add FULL support, with dead-zone settings and finally, rebinds.

As the title implies this is a raw implementation, so bugs are expected, and analog is not taking sensitivity into account.



Thank you for your patience.
